file_transformer.description: File transformer specialist: use for converting files between formats. Can convert Excel to PDF, Excel to Word, Word to PDF, and PDF to Word. Use when tasks require file format conversion or document transformation.

skills.name: Excel To PDF
skills.description: convert an Excel file to PDF format

skills.name: Excel To Word
skills.description: convert an Excel file to a Word document

skills.name: Word To PDF
skills.description: convert a Word document to PDF format

skills.name: PDF To Word
skills.description: convert a PDF file to a Word document

env_explorer.description: Environment explorer specialist: use FIRST to scan /testbed and discover what files, emails, and calendar entries exist before planning actions. Can scan the full workspace and preview text files.

skills.name: Scan Testbed
skills.description: Scan the testbed workspace to discover all files, emails, and calendar entries with types and sizes

skills.name: Read Snippet
skills.description: Read the first lines of a file to preview its content without full parsing

image_creator.description: Image creator specialist: use to generate image files (.jpg/.png) from text or data content. Renders the provided content as a visual image. Choose this agent when the task requires creating an image post, poster, contact card, report image, or any visual output file.

skills.name: Create Image
skills.description: create an image file from text content
